meta.description: How Misaeng Points work at {brand} NYC: earning, using, limits and FAQ. Collect points with food, OPT and job reviews and comments, then use them for coffee chats, lawyer consultations, career mentoring and more.
meta.reviewsDescription: Review requests for extra points on final-result posts.

header.title: Misaeng Points Guide
header.intro: Use the points you earn by helping the community to request rewards like coffee chats and immigration lawyer consultations. Points can't be cashed out, and you need student or professional verification.

redeem.title: Rewards you can get with Misaeng Points
redeem.description: Every session lasts 30 minutes or less. Point costs are set higher than earn rates to cover expert and matching costs.
redeem.callout: Rewards open in stages after you check your balance on My Page. You can request a coffee chat and an immigration lawyer consultation once a month each.

process.title: How to apply
process.description: Four steps from request to finished session.
process.cancelNote: If you cancel before matching, we refund all your points. Same-day cancellations or no-shows after scheduling may not be refunded.

earn.title: Earning Misaeng Points
earn.description: After you verify your school email, you earn points for the activities below.

principlesSection.title: Principles · How it works
principlesSection.description: The program's core principles and the path from your first post to a reward.

limits.title: Limits · Revocation
limits.commentCap: Comments & replies: up to {amount} points a day
limits.noSelfReply: Replies on your own posts or comments: no points
limits.revokeOnDelete: Deleting a post or comment takes back its points
limits.recentActivity: We recommend at least one activity in the last {days} days before you apply

footer.disclaimer: Immigration lawyer consultations are for information only and are separate from case representation. We may change this policy with advance notice.

reward.title: Rewards for contributing
reward.body: The more helpful posts and comments you share, like food, visa and job reviews, the more points you earn.

notCash.title: Connections, not cash
notCash.body: Points can't be exchanged for money. Instead, you trade them for chances to meet experienced professionals and experts.

cost.title: Reflects real costs
cost.body: Misaeng covers expert time and matching costs for coffee chats and immigration lawyer consultations, so using points takes more than earning them.

quality.title: Quality first
quality.body: Spam, duplicate or false posts made just to pile up points won't earn anything and may be taken back.

verify.title: Verify your school
verify.description: Finish school email verification on My Page. You can post, comment and earn points only after you verify.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.description: Write food, OPT or job reviews, or comment on other people's posts. Points are added automatically when you meet the conditions.

balance.title: Check your balance
balance.description: See your total points and history on My Page. Any points taken back for deletions or sanctions show up there too.

redeem.title: Request a reward
redeem.description: Once you have enough points for a reward, send a request. The session happens after matching and scheduling.

apply.title: Request
apply.description: Pick a program on My Page or the rewards page, and send a short summary of your interests and questions.

review.title: Review & deduction
review.description: We check your eligibility, balance and monthly limit, then deduct the points. If we need to schedule, we'll email you.

match.title: Matching
match.description: Misaeng connects you with the right person from our partners, mentors and experts. If matching fails, your points are refunded.

session.title: Session
session.description: Meet online or in person at the agreed time. No-shows or same-day cancellations may not be refunded, per our policy.

food.label: Food review
food.description: Earned when you post a food review with all the required details, like photos, location, menu and price.

conditions.oncePerPost: Paid once when first posted (editing the same post doesn't add more)

notEligible.missingFields: Missing required fields or placeholder content
notEligible.copied: Copying someone else's post or posting duplicates
notEligible.repost: Deleting and reposting the same content (abuse)

food.tip: Photos and specific menu or wait-time details help other students the most.

status.label: OPT, visa & green card review
status.description: {entry} points per timeline step (up to {postMax} per post). Reviews with a final result can earn up to {reviewBonus} more after a Misaeng team review (up to {totalMax} total).

conditions.type: Choose a type: CPT/OPT/STEM OPT/visa/green card
conditions.postMax: Up to {postMax} automatic points per post
conditions.editAdds: Edit your post to add timeline steps and earn more (up to the cap)
conditions.reviewBonus: After adding a final result, tap "Request extra points" → +{reviewBonus} if the team approves

notEligible.privacy: Posts removed for exposing too much personal information
notEligible.capReached: Post already at its automatic cap (extra steps don't earn)
notEligible.noFinalResult: Requesting the review bonus without a final result

status.tip: Add your final result (approval, card received, etc.) to request the team review bonus.

job-review.label: Interviews & jobs
job-review.description: {entry} points per hiring step (timeline), up to {postMax} per post. Add your offer or final result to earn up to {reviewBonus} more after a Misaeng team review (up to {totalMax} total).

conditions.postMax: Up to {postMax} automatic points per post
conditions.editAdds: Edit your post to add timeline steps and earn more (up to the cap)
conditions.reviewBonus: After adding a final result, tap "Request extra points" → +{reviewBonus} if the team approves

notEligible.missingFields: Required steps or type not entered
notEligible.falseInfo: Fake company names or exaggerated details
notEligible.anonymous: Posts on the anonymous board (that board is excluded)
notEligible.capReached: Post already at its automatic cap
notEligible.noFinalResult: Requesting the review bonus without a final result

comment.label: Comments & replies
comment.description: 1 point for each comment or reply on someone else's post.

conditions.publicOthers: Written on someone else's public post or comment

notEligible.ownPost: Replies on your own posts or comments
notEligible.spam: Spam, abuse or meaningless repeated characters
notEligible.copyPaste: Pasting the same sentence over and over

comment.tip: Comments that answer questions or add your own experience help the community most.

referral.label: Referral code used
referral.description: When someone uses your referral code, you get {referral} points. Up to {referralMax} people.

conditions.joined: They signed up with your referral link or linked your code on My Page
conditions.noSelf: You can't refer yourself with your own code

notEligible.maxReached: {referralMax} people have already used your code
notEligible.alreadyLinked: Accounts already linked to another referrer

referral.tip: Copy your referral link on My Page and share it with classmates and friends.

school-verify.label: School email verification
school-verify.description: One time, when you first verify a school email (.edu, etc.) on My Page.

first-post.label: First community post
first-post.description: One time, for your first post on a board that earns points, like food, OPT or job reviews (if it meets the conditions).

noEarn.anonymous: Anonymous board posts and comments (no points, to keep them anonymous)
noEarn.otherBoards: Other boards like roommates, sublets and marketplace (may be added later)
noEarn.reactions: Reactions only, like likes, upvotes or shares
noEarn.adminPosts: Admin posts from the housing team or staff accounts

coffee-chat.label: Coffee chat in your field
coffee-chat.description: A 1:1 chat with someone working or studying in the industry or role you're interested in. Talk about careers, industry culture, New York life tips and more.

includes.meeting: 1:1 meeting online or in person (Zoom or in NYC)
includes.questions: We review 3–5 questions you send ahead of time
includes.scheduling: Scheduling and matching by the Misaeng team

excludes.resumeWriting: Writing your resume or portfolio for you

eligibility.recentActivity: At least one community activity in the last 90 days

coffee-chat.note: Mentors join as volunteers or partners, and Misaeng covers matching and operating costs.

lawyer-consult.label: Immigration lawyer consultation
lawyer-consult.description: A 30-minute Q&A with an immigration lawyer about US immigration and visas, like F-1, OPT, H-1B and green cards.

includes.followUp: Separate guidance if you need further representation

excludes.representation: Representing your case or handling lawsuits
excludes.paperwork: Preparing or filing documents for you
excludes.outcome: Guaranteeing a result (approval, status change, etc.)

eligibility.summary: Send a summary of your immigration or visa question and background when you apply

lawyer-consult.note: Immigration consultations are for information only. An attorney-client relationship may require a separate agreement.

career-mentor.label: Career mentoring
career-mentor.description: Career mentoring on resumes, interviews, switching industries and more. The cost reflects matching with working mentors.

includes.resume: Resume and LinkedIn feedback (if sent ahead)
includes.interview: Q&A on interview and networking strategy

revocation.deleted: If you delete a post or comment, its points are taken back
revocation.guidelines: Content hidden or removed for breaking the community guidelines
revocation.falseInfo: Content confirmed as false or spam (past points may be taken back)
revocation.abuse: Abuse (multiple accounts, manipulation) leads to suspension and loss of your balance

cash.q: Can I exchange points for cash?
cash.a: No. Misaeng Points can't be cashed out, refunded, transferred, sold or moved to another account. You can only use them for reward programs set by {brand} NYC.

comments.q: Can I earn a lot just by commenting?
comments.a: Each comment or reply earns 1 point, but only up to {commentCap} points a day. Comments on your own posts don't count. A coffee chat (120) takes at least 12 days and an immigration lawyer consultation (400) takes 40 days (at the cap) with comments alone, so writing reviews is more efficient.

delete.q: If I delete a post, do I lose the points?
delete.a: Yes. Points for content that's deleted, reported or hidden by sanctions may be taken back. If points you've already used need to be taken back, your balance can go negative.

noVerify.q: Can I earn points without school verification?
noVerify.a: No. You need school email verification to post, comment and earn. You get a one-time 5-point bonus when you verify.

timeline.q: Do OPT and job reviews earn only once per post?
timeline.a: No. You get {entry} points automatically for each timeline step, up to {postMax} per post. If you add your final result and tap "Request extra points," the Misaeng team reviews it and adds {reviewBonus} if approved, for up to {totalMax} total.

sameRestaurant.q: If I review the same restaurant twice, do I earn twice?
sameRestaurant.a: Separate posts can each earn once, but duplicates, copies or spam won't earn and may be taken back.

schedule.q: What if the schedule doesn't work after I request a reward?
schedule.a: If you cancel before matching, we refund all your points. Same-day cancellations or no-shows after confirmation may not be refunded.

lawyerGuarantee.q: Does the immigration lawyer consultation guarantee visa approval or a status change?
lawyerGuarantee.a: No. It only covers general immigration and visa information and processes, and doesn't guarantee any result. Representing your case needs a separate agreement. Non-immigration legal and tax advice isn't included.

policyChange.q: Can the Misaeng Points policy change?
policyChange.a: Yes. Earning and usage rules and point costs may change depending on how things run. When they do, we'll update this page and the policy version. Points you've already earned generally stay.

when.q: When can I start using points?
when.a: Points are added as you take part in the community. Coffee chat and immigration lawyer requests will open in stages, and you can check your balance on My Page.

reward.definition: Non-monetary programs Misaeng offers or arranges, like coffee chats and immigration lawyer consultations.
